purpose: Build your first useful AI website
audience: Adult beginners at a Prompthon practice workshop

sections.heading: Start with a purpose
sections.body: Choose one audience and one useful outcome before asking an agent to build.

sections.heading: Test the real page
sections.body: Check desktop and phone layouts, submit the demo form and inspect browser evidence.

sections.heading: Share a verified preview
sections.body: Review the exact commit, test results and deployment readback before sharing a link.
